shortlist_provenance: These masks passed the already-completed 16-block A7-kappa-0 K011 gate. Prefix2-prefix5 and even failed that gate; suffix5 was subsequently rejected by complete validation as K012.

screen.requirement: Every condition must pass the unchanged 16-block calibration gate and all 338 complete validation blocks.
screen.timing: 16 fixed development inputs, 3 paired eager passes, 48 samples per mode

confirmation.eligibility: Only masks passing all three screen conditions are run.
confirmation.requirement: Every confirmation condition must pass the unchanged 16-block calibration gate and all 338 complete validation blocks.

selection_rule.primary: Among masks passing all six development conditions, maximize the geometric mean paired speedup over the four sparse-family endpoints A4-kappa-0, A4-kappa-0.5, A7-kappa-0, and A7-kappa-0.5.
selection_rule.tie_break: Within 0.005 geometric-mean speedup, choose the mask with fewer adapted layers, then lexical mask id.
selection_rule.failure_path: If no mask qualifies, do not inspect held-out checkpoints; move to a separately recorded exact-tile or native-dispatch development candidate.

scientific_scope: Development-only kernel correctness and timing search. Validation loss and logits are qualification gates, not optimized outcomes.
